look: 14 m mid-size theropod (twice the survivor's height at the hips), olive-green body with dark brown tiger streaks, cream belly and throat, bold black and cream bands down the tail, orange-yellow patch around the eye and snout with a small orange crest above each eye, black-tipped snout, three-fingered arms folded at the chest
texture_prompt: olive green scales with dark brown streaks, cream underside, black and cream banded tail, orange eye patch and crest, matte surface

clips.attack_primary: Snap bite: draws the head back, steps in and darts the jaws down to survivor height
clips.attack_heavy: Hatchet bite: rears back with the jaws gaping (held), then chops the open upper jaw down like an axe and drags back tearing
clips.grab_bite: Lunges low, the three-fingered hands clamp the prey, then two downward bites
clips.kick: Shoulder ram: crouches, winds, then drives the right shoulder forward into prey pressed under its chin
clips.knockdown: Buckles and falls onto its side
clips.alert: Head up, then a roar thrust forward with the jaws wide and a head shake
clips.claw_rake: Arm rake: rears with both arms high, claws spread and trembling, then pitches forward and rakes both arms down through prey under its chest
clips.slash_bite: Hatchet slash: head cocked high to its left with the jaws gaping, then the open upper jaw slashes down and across, and it pulls back off the prey (slash and retreat, Bleed)
clips.check_left: Shoulder-check: leans away, then slams chest, shoulder and hip sideways into prey at its left flank, the near arm raking
clips.check_right: Shoulder-check to its right flank (check_left mirrored)
clips.bite_combo: Chomp combo (the carnotaurus kit): coils with the jaws gaping, chomps left with the left arm raking, chomps right with the right arm, rears up with the jaws wide and both arms raised (the tell), then a MEGA chomp down through the middle with both arms raking and a head shake

tactics._about: # ASSUMPTION (SP-ALLOSAURUS, owner 2026-10-31 'yes allosaurus'): the deinonychus brain scaled to a 14 m animal, hunting in PAIRS (spawn rows count 2: surround puts the two on opposite sides of the prey). No ambush, no pounce or leaps (3 t animal): it opens with a run-in bite (charge), strafing first sometimes. Point blank: prey pressed under its chin gets the SHOULDER RAM (kick, shoves her 4 m); in front at jaw range the GRAB (hands clamp and pin, then two bites) or the HATCHET bite (attack_heavy: held gape telegraph, chop; the only move that applies Bleed: statuses_heavy_only) or the snap bite. reach_m: the jaws are ~7 m ahead of its centre at the bite. ALLOFEEL: the arms reach, grab and rake in every attack. Three more point-blank moves (tactics.moves): the ARM RAKE (claw_rake) on prey 4-6 m out under its chest; the HATCHET SLASH (slash_bite) at jaw range, the open upper jaw slashed across then a pull back (it bleeds, with the hatchet bite: status_clips); the SHOULDER-CHECK (check_left/right) on prey beside its flank (45-120 deg off its facing, within 3.2 m), shoving her sideways. Each has a held tell and a ground ring where it lands (tactics.rings). ALLOFEEL x CARNOFEEL (the carnotaurus kit): its run-in is now a STRAIGHT CHARGE on a locked line that runs through her (pass-through for charge_pass_s) and knocks her down on contact, even when the damage roll misses; at the end of the line it wheels round on a wide arc (charge_arc_r_m, no pivot), charges back once, and after a landed charge dashes in for the CHOMP COMBO (bite_combo: chomp left, chomp right, rear-up tell, MEGA chomp, the arms raking on each), which is also a point-blank move.
